answerable.question: How many days do I have to return an item?
answerable.reference: You can return an item within 30 days of the delivery date shown on the order (calendar days from when the carrier marked it delivered).

answerable.question: Can I return headphones if one side stopped working?
answerable.reference: Yes. A defective item, such as headphones where one side cuts out, can be returned within 30 days of delivery, with free return shipping. After 30 days it's covered by the 1-year warranty.

answerable.question: I opened my laptop and it works fine but I changed my mind. Can I return it?
answerable.reference: No. Opened items that work as intended can't be returned for a change of mind; only unopened or defective items within 30 days are eligible.

answerable.question: Is return shipping free?
answerable.reference: Return shipping is free for defective items. For unopened items returned for any other reason, a $6.95 return label fee is deducted from the refund.

answerable.question: How long does it take to get my refund?
answerable.reference: Refunds go to the original payment method after the item arrives and passes inspection (up to 2 business days); the bank may take a further 5-7 business days to show it.

answerable.question: Can I return a Brightline gift card?
answerable.reference: No. Brightline Gift Cards can never be returned, refunded or exchanged for cash (except where required by law).

answerable.question: Can I return Shield Antivirus after I've revealed the licence key?
answerable.reference: No. Software licences and digital downloads such as Shield Antivirus can't be returned once the licence key has been revealed.

answerable.question: How many items can I put in one return request?
answerable.reference: A single return request can include up to 5 items; create a second request for more.

answerable.question: Can I exchange an item for a different colour?
answerable.reference: Brightline doesn't offer direct exchanges. Return the item for a refund and place a new order for the replacement.

answerable.question: Do I get my delivery charge back when I return something?
answerable.reference: Original delivery charges are refunded only when the item was defective or Brightline sent the wrong item.

answerable.question: Do you deliver to Canada?
answerable.reference: Yes. Brightline delivers to addresses in the United States and Canada.

answerable.question: How much does express delivery cost and how fast is it?
answerable.reference: Express delivery costs $14.99 and takes 1-2 business days after the order ships.

answerable.question: When is standard shipping free?
answerable.reference: Standard delivery (3-5 business days) is free on orders of $50 or more; otherwise it costs $4.99.

answerable.question: Which carriers do you ship with?
answerable.reference: Brightline ships with ParcelLine, SwiftShip and NorthPost, and emails the carrier and tracking number when the order ships.

answerable.question: My order says delivered but I haven't received it. What should I do?
answerable.reference: Wait until the end of the next business day, check around your property and with neighbours and look for a carrier notice; if it still hasn't arrived, contact Brightline within 7 days of the delivery date to open an investigation.

answerable.question: My package arrived damaged. What do I do?
answerable.reference: Take photos of the packaging and item and contact Brightline within 48 hours; damaged-on-arrival items are treated as defective returns with free return shipping.

answerable.question: What does next-day delivery cost and what's the cut-off time?
answerable.reference: Next-day delivery costs $24.99 and arrives the next business day if ordered before 2 pm ET.

answerable.question: Can you ship a laptop to my P.O. box?
answerable.reference: No. Brightline can't deliver orders containing laptops or phones to P.O. boxes.

answerable.question: How long is the warranty on your products?
answerable.reference: Hardware comes with a 1-year limited warranty from delivery; laptops have a 2-year limited warranty.

answerable.question: Does the warranty cover a cracked screen from a drop?
answerable.reference: No. The standard warranty doesn't cover accidental damage such as drops or cracked screens; Brightline Care+ adds accidental damage protection.

answerable.question: What is Brightline Care+?
answerable.reference: Care+ extends cover to 3 years in total and adds accidental damage protection (up to two claims per year, $49 service fee per claim). It must be bought within 60 days of delivery.

answerable.question: How do I make a warranty claim?
answerable.reference: Open a support ticket (via Brightline Assistant or support) with the order number, the product's serial number and a description of the fault, ideally with photos or video.

answerable.question: How long does a warranty repair take?
answerable.reference: Once approved, Brightline repairs or replaces the product within 10 business days of receiving it, or refunds if it can't be repaired or replaced.

answerable.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answerable.reference: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Brightline Gift Cards.

answerable.question: When will my card be charged?
answerable.reference: The payment method is authorised when the order is placed and charged when the order ships.

answerable.question: What is Pay in 4?
answerable.reference: For orders between $100 and $1,500 you can pay in four interest-free payments every two weeks; approval uses a soft credit check that doesn't affect your credit score.

answerable.question: The price dropped after I bought it. Can I get the difference back?
answerable.reference: Yes, with price protection: if the price drops within 14 days of delivery, Brightline refunds the difference once per item (not for clearance, open-box or flash-sale prices). Open a ticket with the order number and item.

answerable.question: Can I split a payment between two cards?
answerable.reference: No. You can only split a payment across one gift card and one card.

answerable.question: How do I cancel my order?
answerable.reference: Orders can be cancelled free of charge while the status is Placed, before shipping, by contacting support or asking the assistant to open a ticket; usually processed within 2 business hours. Shipped orders can't be cancelled but can be returned.

answerable.question: Can I change the delivery address after my order has shipped?
answerable.reference: No. The address can only be changed while the order is Placed; after shipping the carrier may allow a redirect on their website using the tracking number.

answerable.question: Where can I find my order number?
answerable.reference: The order number starts with BL- followed by five digits and is in the subject line of the order confirmation email.

answerable.question: What are your support hours?
answerable.reference: Monday to Friday 8 am - 8 pm ET and Saturday 9 am - 5 pm ET; closed Sundays and US public holidays. The assistant is available 24/7.

answerable.question: How quickly do you reply to support tickets?
answerable.reference: Standard tickets get a reply within 1 business day; escalated or high-priority tickets within 4 business hours.

answerable.question: How can I talk to a real person?
answerable.reference: Ask Brightline Assistant to talk to a human at any time; it escalates the conversation to the support team as a high-priority ticket with a summary.

answerable.question: What do you need from me to look up my order?
answerable.reference: Your order number and the email address used on that order; both must match the same order.

answerable.question: Will Brightline ever ask for my password or card number?
answerable.reference: No. Brightline never asks for passwords, full card numbers, CVV or one-time security codes in chat, email or by phone.

answerable.question: How long do you keep chat transcripts?
answerable.reference: Chat transcripts are kept for 90 days and then deleted automatically.

answerable.question: One ear of my Aurora headphones keeps cutting out. What should I try?
answerable.reference: Check the left/right balance setting, reset the headphones by holding power for 10 seconds and pairing again, update firmware in the Brightline Audio app, and try another device. If it persists it's likely defective (return within 30 days, otherwise warranty).

answerable.question: How long does the battery last on the Aurora Wireless Headphones?
answerable.reference: Up to 40 hours with noise cancelling off and 30 hours with it on; a 10-minute charge gives about 4 hours.

answerable.question: Do Brightline gift cards expire?
answerable.reference: No. Brightline gift cards never expire.
